We have data blocks with quotes. Need to compare laptop quotations (RFQ-2026-014). We have four vendors: Acme, Orbital, BrightPath, Nimbus. Need to compare total delivered price, lead time, warranty. Determine cheapest vendor. Then search web for recent reviews of cheapest vendor and summarise them. End with line 'Best price: <vendor>'.

We need to compute total delivered price for each vendor.

Acme: unit price 742, quantity 50 => subtotal 37,100. Shipping 450. Total delivered 37,550.

Orbital: unit price 760, quantity 50 => 38,000. Volume discount 4% for orders over 40 units. So discount 4% of 38,000 = 1,520. So discounted total 36,480. Shipping included. Total delivered 36,480.

BrightPath: unit price 715, quantity 50 => 35,750. Shipping 0. Total delivered 35,750.

Nimbus: unit price 728, quantity 50 => 36,400. Express shipping 300. Total delivered 36,700.

Thus cheapest is BrightPath with 35,750.

Now search web for recent reviews of BrightPath Systems. Use search_web tool.
